title: Meet Yuan UP.
voice: The 2027 BYD Yuan UP, also known as Atto 2,
is a compact pure electric SUV built for urban commuting and everyday use.

title: Built for the city.
voice: Yuan UP delivers 401 kilometres CLTC range with a 70 kilowatt front motor,
making it a practical choice for city routes and light fleet operation.

title: Blade battery. Daily confidence.
voice: It is equipped with a 45.12 kilowatt-hour BYD Blade LFP battery,
designed for stability, durability and reliable daily performance.

title: More uptime. Less waiting.
voice: DC fast charging from 30 to 80 percent takes about 30 minutes under suitable conditions,
reducing waiting time for commercial operation.

title: Connected. Aware. Confident.
voice: 360-degree camera and DiPilot 100 support an intelligent and confident driving experience.

title: Compact outside. Flexible inside.
voice: With a 2620 millimetre wheelbase, five-door five-seat layout and split folding rear seats,
Yuan UP balances passenger comfort and flexible cargo space.
